summary: Fine: the auto-bet obeyed every printed rule in all 99 recorded bets (0 violations; 51 under rules identical to Settings, no stake over $3.50, none over 24 h out since the guard shipped), CNO's edge inside 24 h is real (CLV +1.52% on 240 closes/87 games) and the trap guard did not fail (15 of the 16 "recent early bets" predate it, the 16th is Tj's hand bet). Wrong or unproven: overall CLV is only +0.36% [-0.35, +1.01] on 532 closes/143 games against a shown EV of +3.05%, bets 6 h or more before the start show no edge (6-24 h -0.11% on 145, 24 h+ -0.95% on 238, with 9-14% closing 10+ pts worse), results (-3.5% ROI, z -1.7) cannot judge a +1-3% edge, and two imported lock legs that won are stuck open for a tap. What matters most: CLV is real only under 6 h before the start (+2.89% on 149 closes in 66 games, +3.52 pts above the rest, p<0.001, same in both date halves), so the question for Tj is whether the auto-bet should keep placing the 6-24 h bets (its own 32 post-guard closes there are +1.65%, lower CI bound +0.02).

findings.title: The edge is real only close to the start: bets placed under 6 h before the start beat the close, and the difference from earlier bets holds in both date halves, on both close sources and in every placer group
findings.evidence: Base = the app's own filter (outliers and lock legs out: 657 bets, 532 with a close, 143 games). Time to start: <6 h 164 bets, 149 closes in 66 games, CLV +2.89% [95% game-cluster CI +2.32, +3.58], beat the close 81.9%, EV at bet +3.33%; 6-24 h 221 bets, 145 closes/67 games, CLV -0.11% [-1.55, +1.13], 55.2%, EV +3.03%; over 24 h 272 bets, 238 closes/74 games, CLV -0.95% [-2.27, +0.20], 54.6%, EV +2.90%. Difference <6 h minus 6 h+ = +3.52 pts [+2.55, +4.63], 0 of 4,000 game-bootstrap draws <=0 (p<0.001); <6 h minus 6-24 h = +3.00 [+1.80, +4.53]; 6-24 h minus 24 h+ = +0.84 [-1.06, +2.60], P(<=0)=0.18 (not separable). By date half (cut Sep 30, equal games): H1 <6 h +1.61% [0.55, 2.43] (52 closes/25 games) vs 6-24 h -0.15, 24 h+ -1.20; H2 <6 h +3.58% [2.84, 4.73] (97/41) vs -0.07 and -0.59. By close source: tracker reads <6 h +3.67 (98) / 6-24 h +0.21 (65) / 24 h+ -0.89 (150); Novig-trades closes +1.09 (44) / -0.65 (74) / -1.79 (76). By placer (<6 h / 6-24 h / 24 h+): auto-bet +3.22 (39 closes) / +0.84 (38) / -0.14 (42); bet sheet +4.13 (45) / -1.91 (21) / -2.73 (16); hand before Oct 2 +1.84 (56) / -0.35 (77) / -0.98 (180). The shown EV predicts CLV only near the start: slope of CLV on EV (CLV pts per EV pt) <6 h +1.11 [0.56, 1.72] (145 closes/64 games), 6-24 h +0.33 [-0.57, 1.19], 24 h+ -0.02 [-1.15, 1.18]; inside <6 h CLV rises with EV: EV<3% +1.96 (60), 3-4% +3.46 (51), 4%+ +4.35 (34). Part of the near-start result is mechanical (less time left, so the fair has less room to move and CLV stays near the EV): what the data adds is that the shown EV can only be trusted there. (Section: The bet as placed, Time to the start; the 694 bets.)
codePointers: data/.../tracker/ClosingLine.kt (TRUE_CLOSE_MS=15 min: a tracker-read close is at most 15 min before the start)
findings.suggestedAction: No change needed. Keep quoting CLV by time to start; the pooled number hides this.

findings.title: Overall CLV is +0.36%, not distinguishable from zero, while the shown EV is +3.05%: results are -3.5% ROI, consistent with a small edge plus bad luck, and no ROI split can be read
findings.evidence: All base bets: 532 closes/143 games, CLV +0.36% [-0.35, +1.01], beat the close 62.4%, EV at bet +3.05% (gap 2.7 pts); on close_ok only (drops 45 Novig-trades closes of 1-2 trades) 487 closes/134 games +0.59% [-0.18, +1.32], 64.7%. P(true CLV <= 0) = 0.14. Results: 299-351-3, profit -29.14 on 828.96 staked = ROI -3.52% [-11.23, +4.46] (the app prints -2.0% on its Results line because that figure includes the lock-hedge legs, +12.3 on 15.5 staked; the picks alone are -3.5%); expected from the shown EV +24.54, actual -35.46 over 589 settled bets with an EV, SD 35.3 so z = -1.70 (one-sided p = 0.045; the app prints -1.7 SD, reproduced); against the CLV-implied edge (+5.59 expected over the same 589 bets) z = -1.16 (p = 0.12). Date halves: H1 (to Sep 30) -0.36% [-1.62, +0.78] (260 closes/100 games), H2 +1.04% [+0.12, +1.93] (272/69). Era: placed before Oct 3 12:27 ET (before the trap guard shipped) CLV -0.42% [-1.32, +0.39] on 388 closes/120 games, beat 54.9%; after +2.44% [+1.30, +3.68] on 144 closes/45 games, beat 82.6%, EV +3.41%. Per-bet SD of CLV 7.7 pts, of profit per $ staked 1.04: confirming a +1.0% CLV takes ~250 closes (+1.5% ~110, +3% ~27); confirming ROI +3% takes ~4,800 bets (+5% ~1,740), so ROI and expected-vs-actual cannot judge the edge at this size; CLV can. About 2.3 days of first-look data in a changing app: H2 is the only out-of-sample-ish check.
findings.suggestedAction: Judge edges by CLV by time-to-start group, not by ROI. About 250 more closes inside the guard window would settle a +1% CLV claim.

findings.title: QUESTION FOR TJ: do bets 6-24 h before the start (the 24 h trap-guard window) earn their keep? All placers pooled they show no edge and a fat left tail; the auto-bet alone looks better post-guard, on 32 closes
findings.evidence: Pooled 6-24 h: 145 closes/67 games CLV -0.11% [-1.55, +1.13], beat 55.2% (EV shown +3.03%, so a 3.1-pt shortfall). Left tail (closed over 10 pts worse than the price paid): <6 h 1 of 149 (0.7%), 6-24 h 13 of 145 (9.0%), over 24 h 33 of 238 (13.9%); within 24 h 14 of 294 (4.8%); over 24 h vs within 24 h Fisher OR 3.2, p = 0.0003. Medians: over 24 h +0.65%, within 24 h +2.04%, so a typical early bet is fine and the mean is carried by the tail (winsorised 5/95: -0.67% vs +1.60%). But since the guard shipped (placed from Oct 3 12:27 ET) the auto-bet's own 6-24 h bets are +1.65% [+0.02, +3.19] on 32 closes/19 games, beat 81.2%, one tail bet of 32, while Tj's hand bet-sheet bets 6-24 h are -3.19% [-8.38, +4.07] on 15 closes/10 games with 3 tail bets, and pre-guard 6-24 h bets -0.50% on 91 closes (9 tails). 34 of the 73 auto-bets placed since the guard shipped were more than 6 h out (max 19.07 h; first on Oct 3 21:40 ET), so the 24 h window is what lets the auto-bet place them. Auto-bet <6 h post-guard +3.34% [1.90, 5.16] on 36 closes. The evidence favours keeping the window as is for the auto-bet (its filters seem to remove the tail) but 32 closes in 19 games cannot confirm that: the lower CI bound is +0.02. To settle: ~50 more auto-bet closes in 6-24 h (80 in all, about 5 days at ~11 a day) to get the CI half-width from +-1.6 to +-1.0 pt; the tail share (1/32 vs 3/15 hand) needs ~100 hand bets. Not a loosening; narrowing to 6 h would drop ~47% of post-guard auto-bets (34 of 73) and is Tj's call.
findings.suggestedAction: Ask Tj: keep the guard at 24 h for the auto-bet, or 12 h/6 h? Evidence above; decide after ~50 more auto-bet closes between 6 and 24 h, or now if he prefers lower variance. Do not change without his yes.

findings.title: The trap guard did not fail: 15 of the 16 "early bets in the last 3 days" were placed before the guard existed, and the 16th was Tj's own hand bet; no auto-bet or bid fill since the guard shipped was more than 24 h out
findings.evidence: The health finding counts bets placed more than 24 h before the start since Oct 3 00:08 ET: 16. Who: 3 auto-bets (Oct 3 00:25, 02:04:47 and 02:04:52 ET; v0.52.0 preset "Super CLV (low volume)" and v0.53.0 "Volume + safe CLV" x2; 43.9, 38.3, 38.3 h out), 12 hand bets through the Bet sheet (Oct 3 00:21-10:23 ET; v0.52.0 x7 [Volume CLV 3, Super CLV (low volume) 2, Super Bet (Low Volume) 2], v0.53.0 x2, v0.54.0 x3 "Volume + safe CLV"; 26.7-43.8 h out), 1 hand Bet-sheet bet on Oct 5 15:55 ET (v0.66.0, preset "2 (Safe CLV)", MLS Total Goals Over 3.5, 28.6 h out, still open), and 0 bid fills. The trap guard first shipped in v0.55.0 (build Oct 3 16:27Z = 12:27 ET; 6 h default; the first recorded bet under it is v0.56.1 at 15:48 ET), so 15 of the 16 predate it; hand bets are only warned by the guard (OpportunitySheet trap note), never blocked. Since the guard shipped: 73 auto-bets, max 19.07 h to start, 0 over 24 h; 17 bid fills, max 8.5 h; 72 hand Bet-sheet bets, 23 over 6 h, 12 over 12 h, 1 over 24 h. The 16 early bets: 13 with a close, mean CLV -6.44% (3 auto -12.42%, 10 sheet -4.64%), 3 closed over 10 pts worse, $26.95 staked, -$5.35. The 238 early bets with a close (placed Sep 25 - Oct 5) are 180 hand bets before the records started, 42 auto-bets (the auto-bet ran with no guard Oct 1 - Oct 3 12:27) and 16 Bet-sheet bets.

findings.title: The "Early bets (CLV)" health finding reads like a guard failure but cannot tell hand bets or pre-guard bets from auto-bets, and "Edge accuracy" pools 6-24 h with <6 h and reports OK
findings.evidence: HealthChecks.kt line 493 counts `recent` over every bet not a lock whose lead exceeds the window and whose createdAtMs is within 3 days: it includes hand Bet-sheet bets and bets placed before the guard shipped (15 of the 16). "Edge accuracy (CLV)" judges all bets within the guard window (windowH = trapEarlyHours = 24): +1.41% on 294 closes, "the edges hold up", while 6-24 h alone is -0.11% on 145 and only <6 h (+2.89%, 149) carries the edge; the shown EV has slope 0.33 on CLV in 6-24 h vs 1.11 under 6 h.
findings.suggestedAction: Split the "recent early bets" count by placer (auto/bids/alerts vs hand) and by whether the guard existed; add the <6 h group beside the window group. Needs no rule change.

findings.title: Which trap-guard window, stake cap and limits were in force when a bet was placed cannot be read from the bet record or the timeline, so the history of the 6 h -> 24 h change is inferred, not logged
findings.evidence: The setting is trapEarlyHours (ScanSettings.kt:372; default 6, choices 0/3/6/12/24); it is not part of a preset or of the rules string on each bet (PresetRules.summary), and the EVENT TIMELINE logs only some settings changes. Inferred from the 73 post-guard auto-bets: 6 h in force Oct 3 15:55-20:17 ET (every auto-bet <= 5.4 h), 24 h (or off) by Oct 3 21:40 ET (5 auto-bets at 15.3-18.7 h in 23 s, v0.58.2 preset "2 (Safe CLV) (changed)"), max 19.07 h since. The skip counters (since Oct 1) show "more than 6 h" 303 times and "more than 12 h" 151 times, so 12 h was in force for a while too (not in the top-15 list: 24 h skips, 2 in the last check) but when is unknowable from the file. The 32 auto-bets of Oct 1 - Oct 2 14:20 ET (before atBet, v0.46.0) have no rules at all. The per-bet audit therefore had to use each bet's printed rules, and the per-bet maximum stake, the day limit and the game limit in force are not recorded either.
codePointers: data/.../tracker/AtBet.kt (add trapEarlyHours, max stake, day/game limit)
data/.../diag/ (log trapEarlyHours changes on the timeline)

findings.title: AUDIT of the auto-bet against the rules printed in Settings: no violation in 99 recorded auto-bets (the one borderline is display rounding); the 51 placed under rules identical to the printed ones obey every limit
findings.evidence: 131 auto-bet rows (127 in the app's stats + 4 outliers); 99 carry a record with the rules in force, 32 (Oct 1 08:44 - Oct 2 14:20 ET) have none (only EV >= 2.70% and odds <= +141 checkable). Against each bet's OWN recorded rules: 0 violations; one borderline, a bet at 3.292% under preset "4 (Super CLV)" printed as edge >= 3.3% (pct() rounds to 0.1%, a minimum of 3.25-3.35% prints 3.3%). Against the CURRENT printed rules, bets whose recorded rules equal them (51: preset "2 (Safe CLV)" v0.56.1-v0.68.0, Oct 3 16:56 - Oct 5 19:57 ET): 0 violations; min edge 2.505%, odds -150 to +130, books pricing both sides >= 3 (rule: 2), agreeing >= 3, sharp veto PASSED 50 (min sharp EV 1.79%, bar 1%) and NO_SHARP 1, max 19.07 h to start (guard 24 h), max stake $3.4968 (auto cap $3.50; the "$5 a bet" is the API per-bet maximum for hand bets, a hand bet was $4.9984). Of the 99 recorded, 71 differ from the current printed rules in nothing; the other 28 differ only by their own earlier preset (some in more than one way): 22 were placed over 24 h out before the guard shipped (all <= Oct 3 02:04 ET), 5 at odds +133 to +141 under presets whose own limit was +150, 2 game totals under "every kind of bet" presets (v0.47.0), 2 with sharp EV 0.57% and 0.71% before the 1% bar existed (v0.56.0), 1 at 2.46% under a preset with edge >= 2%. Of the 32 unrecorded, 24 were over 24 h out (all before the guard) and 2 at +135 and +141. Money limits: biggest API-bet day $118.32 (Oct 4, 66 bets; auto only $57.14) vs $500; biggest game by simple sum of every API stake $54.13 (31 bets, 4 of them auto: Falcons @ Saints; Lions @ Panthers $50.52), none over $70, 3 games over $25, after the per-game limit shipped (v0.59.0, Oct 4 01:09 ET) the largest was $45.23; largest burst 5 auto-bets in one 23 s cycle (cap 5 a cycle); nearest to the start 74 s (the code needs 60 s); fill price equals the judged price on all 99; all 5 post-guard auto game lines carry a Novig-move record (3 CLEAR, 2 NO LEVEL, = the counters); no market had a second auto-bet; one auto-bet had Tj's own opposite hand bet 3 h later (allowed).

findings.title: The auto-bet's 2.5% edge rule is judged on CNO's EV, the app's own book check only has to be above 0; 9 of 99 auto-bets had a check EV under 2.5% (min 0.65%), and 10 of 96 stakes exceeded a quarter-Kelly on the recorded fair
findings.evidence: AutoBet.judge(rules, shownEv=CNO's EV, check, ...) tests minEv on shownEv and only `check.ev > 0` on the book check (AutoBet.kt:120-133). Auto-bets with the app's own book-check EV below 2.5%: 9 (check EV 0.65%-2.4%, CLV -0.15% [-2.11, +1.01] on 8 closes/6 games). Staking: AutoBet.kellyStake sizes on CNO's fair (or the sharp book's if lower), but the record's fullKelly (AtBets.cno, AtBet.kt:194) is computed on the book check's fair: 10 of 96 recorded stakes are 1.01x-3.80x a quarter-Kelly of the recorded fullKelly (e.g. check EV 0.65% vs CNO 2.55% staked $2.36, 3.8x), $4.44 extra on $17.74 of $175.90 staked. No rule is broken (the stake cap $3.50 held), but the Settings sentence "an edge of +2.5% or more" does not say whose edge, and the diagnostics fullKelly does not describe the stake.
findings.suggestedAction: QUESTION FOR TJ (rule change, not an action): size and gate on the lower of CNO's and the book check's EV. 9 of 99 bets (9%) would have been affected and their CLV is flat, so this is a tidy-up; ~60 such bets would settle whether they are worse.

findings.title: Vigilant's own edge runs 2.6 pts above the close; the gap sits in game totals, fairs with no sharp book, and the oldest hand bets, while a Pinnacle-in-the-fair edge held
findings.evidence: Vigilant within 24 h: 67 bets, 54 closes/31 games, CLV +0.92% [-0.46, +2.18], beat 57.4%, EV on those +3.5% (gap 2.58 pts; CNO within 24 h +1.52%, EV 3.07%, gap 1.55); all-time 103 bets, 84 closes/53 games +0.29% [-1.32, +1.95]; over 24 h 30 closes -0.83% [-4.27, +3.32]. By market within 24 h: player props 33 closes/14 games +1.09% [-0.96, +2.78], 63.6% (EV 3.64%); game totals (Total 9 closes -0.85%, 33% beat; 1H totals 2, -3.61%) 11 closes/11 games -1.35% [-3.94, +2.09], 27% beat; spreads 4 closes +1.60%; team totals 4 closes +3.45% [1.94, 4.57], 100% beat. By what made the fair (basis matched from the newest-30 list in the diagnostics, 26 of 30 matched): Pinnacle in the fair 14 closes/10 games +3.50% [+1.61, +5.75], 78.6% beat (the app's own all-time line for it: 20 bets, +1.1% on 16, so the 2 older Pinnacle-labelled bets averaged about -16%); exchange sharp only (Kalshi/ProphetX, +-FanDuel) 9 closes in 3 games +1.43% [-0.21, +5.32]; books' average only 3 closes -0.03%, 0 of 3 won (EV shown +4.6%); fair basis not recorded (older bets) 58 closes/42 games -0.64% [-3.01, +1.46], 44.8% beat. The gap is mostly the old regime: Vigilant bets placed before Oct 2 14:00 ET (hand, no records) 29 closes/20 games -0.42% [-2.59, +1.42] at EV 2.97%; after, 25 closes/11 games +2.47% [+1.12, +4.56] at EV 4.05%; difference +2.89 [+0.56, +6.16], P(<=0)=0.007. Newer Vigilant bets (17 bid fills +2.57% on 16 closes in 6 games; 12 sheet bets) are 6-11 games each: small. Vigilant's scanner is the weaker edge by this measure but only the old half is clearly weak. Weak spot by market: totals; by fair: books-average-only. Both small.
findings.suggestedAction: Nothing to change on the evidence. Re-judge after ~100 more Vigilant closes placed since Oct 2; ask Tj before restricting Vigilant's bets to Pinnacle-in-the-fair (14 closes in 10 games is not enough).

By kind: player props 277 bets/208 closes/76 games +1.70% [+0.86, +2.54], 74.5% beat; team totals 6 closes +5.92% [1.16, 10.69]; totals 12 closes -1.38%; spreads 10 closes -0.35%. All-time CNO 552 bets, 447 closes/122 games +0.39% [-0.38, +1.14], 64.4%. (Section: Accuracy by scanner and by market; Each scanner by market.)

findings.title: Game totals and spreads lose to the close (and match the preset that keeps totals out of the auto-bet); the evidence is 61 and 68 closes, so it is suggestive only
findings.evidence: All base: Total 72 bets, 61 closes/52 games CLV -1.08% [-3.08, +0.88], beat 41.0%, P(true CLV <= 0) = 0.85; Spread 76 bets, 68 closes/54 games -1.03% [-3.92, +1.45], 52.9%, P = 0.76; Moneyline 10 bets, 9 closes -2.17% [-7.30, +2.57]; 1H/period totals 10 closes +1.43%; team totals 20 bets, 18 closes/17 games +2.51% [+0.10, +4.97]. findings.title: By sport the close confirms hockey and basketball props, is flat on NFL, and does not confirm college football or baseball; every group is a few dozen games
findings.evidence: Base, all times: Hockey 50 bets, 44 closes/25 games CLV +2.94% [+1.02, +4.49], beat 81.8% (P(<=0)=0.004); Basketball (WNBA, 1 NBA) 66 bets, 56 closes/12 games +2.38% [+1.13, +3.83] but ROI -15.9%; NFL 324 bets, 293 closes/28 games +0.17% [-0.64, +0.94] (within 24 h 143 closes +1.34% [+0.35, +2.44]); College football 95 bets, 85 closes/55 games -0.99% [-3.63, +1.20] (within 24 h 19 closes +0.69%); Baseball 53 bets, 46 closes/17 games -0.50% [-2.58, +1.09] (within 24 h 40 closes +0.19%). findings.title: Sharp-veto, books-agreeing, page-age, preset and version splits show no usable signal beyond time to start: groups are 16-145 closes and confounded; the 1-2% sharp-EV dip is 4 far-out bets
findings.evidence: The bet as placed (194 bets with a record, 182 closes): sharp verdict PASSED 145 closes/46 games +1.53% [+0.36, +2.73], 79.3% beat; NO_SHARP 16 closes/14 games -1.74% [-7.48, +3.63], 50%; VETOED 4 (all Tj's hand bets) +4.42%, 4 of 4 beat; ANCHORED 6 (bid fills) +1.27%. Sharp book's own EV band: <1% 8 closes +3.59%; 1-2% 16 closes/10 games -5.48% [-11.67, -0.57] but within 24 h only 11 closes -0.39% (the dip is four bets placed 18-49 h out closing -41.6, -36.3, -20.3, -3.7); 2-3% 31 +2.12%; 3-4% 29 +0.64%; 4%+ 71 +3.11%. Auto-bets within 24 h by sharp EV: <2% 4 closes -1.37%; 2-3% 16/13 games +2.08% [0.33, 3.85]; 3-4% 13 +1.15%; 4%+ 36/26 games +3.25% [2.21, 4.20]. Books agreeing: 3 +2.53% (27 closes), 4 +2.38% (33), 5 -0.05% (36), 6+ +0.96% (69): flat. Page age: <30 s +2.36% (81 closes/38 games), 30 s-2 min +0.78% (59), 2-10 min -1.05% [-5.66, +3.53] on 25 closes with ROI -48.7% on 26 bets (7-19). Preset "2 (Safe CLV)" 99 bets +2.70% [+1.56, +4.19] on 95 closes/34 games, but 75 of its 99 bets were under 6 h (+3.67% there; 6-24 h -0.70% on 21); "Volume + safe CLV" 36 bets -0.03% on 33 closes (15 of 36 were over 24 h). By version, none is stable (v0.59.1 +3.85% on 33 closes/14 games; v0.61.0 -3.47% on 12/4 games). Caesars as the sharp book: 22 closes/15 games +5.09% [4.13, 6.13], 10 of the 22 NHL shots on goal, median 3.2 h to the start. None of this separates from time to start with this sample.
findings.suggestedAction: No change. Raising the sharp bar from 1% to 2% would have removed 4 of 72 within-24 h auto-bets; ~60 sub-2% bets (~40 days) would settle whether they are worse.

findings.title: CLV mixes close sources that disagree by 1.5-2.6 pts at the same time to start: Novig-trades closes (45 of 194 are 1-2 trades) read lower than tracker-read closes
findings.evidence: Close source (base): tracker read before the start 313 closes/69 games CLV +0.77% [-0.27, +1.76], beat 69.6%; Novig's last trades 194 closes/81 games -0.70% [-1.81, +0.27], 47.4%; ESPN 14 +3.85% (85.7%); Pinnacle via ParlayAPI 11 +2.98% (90.9%); 125 bets (19%) have no close (59 are the Sep 26 imported batch, 66 of 593 others = 11%). Same time-to-start bucket: <6 h tracker +3.67% (98) vs Novig trades +1.09% (44); 6-24 h +0.21% vs -0.65%; over 24 h -0.89% vs -1.79%. The Novig-trades close is the volume-weighted average of the trades priced on this one outcome in the last half hour (HistoricalCloses.kt:281): a price, not a de-vigged fair. The Tracker and the diagnostics headline CLV (+0.4% on 547) pools all four. Dropping Novig-trades closes of under 3 trades moves overall CLV from +0.36% (532) to +0.59% (487).
findings.suggestedAction: Print CLV per close source in the accuracy block and leave 1-2-trade closes out of the headline (the scan study already does).

findings.title: The 2 open bets that need a tap (Ollie Gordon Over 29.5 and Bhayshul Tuten Over 53.5) are handled safely but not completely: both won, the app already knows the other leg lost, and they sit open 32-35 h after the start
findings.evidence: Held both sides: Gordon Over 29.5 +108, $1.4976 (312 contracts; the pick Under 29.5, same size, graded lost by the score feeds; Dolphins @ Vikings, started Oct 4 4:05 PM ET) and Tuten Over 53.5 +115, $0.00465 (1 contract; the pick Under 53.5, 232 contracts, $1.0788, graded lost; JAX @ CIN, started Oct 4 1:00 PM ET). Both Overs won (ESPN box scores: Gordon 100 yards, Tuten 73; RESEARCH.md section 87), so the Over legs are worth +$1.62 (Gordon pair locks +$0.12 net) and +$0.0054. Why they wait: ApiSettler finds no ledger payout and no held position, bothSidesHeld is true, so v0.62.0/v0.63.0 refuse the silent loss (note BOTH_HELD_SILENT) and leave it to a tap; the feed grader cannot read their imported wording ("Ollie Gordon II 29.5 RUSHING_YARDS"). The guard is right: it stopped the wrong double-LOST grade (the 2 wrong grades of 9 silent grades, RESEARCH 87.1; the other 7 silent losses, NCAAF, were correct per ESPN finals). What is missing: in a two-way half-point market a feed-graded LOST sibling proves this leg won (the code has the reverse, OTHER_SIDE_LOST, but not this), so the Tracker could grade both on its own; ApiSettler.bothSides() only runs when Novig's ledger paid something. Why Novig's ledger shows no payout row for these two imported legs (the other locked markets payouts were found) is still unknown (needs a ledger read: Settings > Diagnostics > Grading check). Effect on the stats is small: the Locked-in card is short +$0.12; Tracker profit short +$0.0054 on the dust leg.
findings.suggestedAction: When both sides are held in a two-outcome half-point market and one leg is graded LOST from the score feeds (not from Novig's silence), grade the other leg WON with the evidence. Tj can tap both in the Novig app meanwhile.

findings.title: Two imported Novig fills (a lock leg without lockFor and a 1-contract probe order) are counted as Vigilant bets in CLV and "Other", and a one-contract bet's +39.8% CLV sits in the averages
findings.evidence: The two legs above are imported from Novig's fills (source "vigilant", no EV, raw market wording, no lockFor): they are the "Vigilant - Other: 2 bets, CLV +12.0% on 2" and "Market Other: 4 bets" lines (CLV +39.8% on the 1-contract Over 53.5 and -15.7% on the Gordon lock leg), and they count in "Closing line value (all time)". A hedge leg's CLV says nothing about an edge (ClosingLine.closeOf leaves lock legs out; the Gordon leg is not tagged as one), and the Tuten leg is a $0.00465 probe order. Effect on the all-time mean: +0.04 pts of 547 closes. Also 64 imported bets with no league (Sep 26 batch, +$6.32 on $64, 5 with a close) are in the results line but have no EV.
findings.suggestedAction: Link an imported fill to the pick it hedges (same market, other outcome) and treat it as a lock leg; leave imported bets without an EV out of the CLV splits.

findings.title: Player-prop results are 1.9-2.3 SD below expectation while their CLV is positive; grading is not the cause on the evidence, but 7 losses rest on Novig's silence alone
findings.evidence: Player props (410 settled with an EV): expected from the shown EV +18.95, actual -53.33, SD 31.0, z = -2.33 (one-sided p = 0.010); against the CLV-implied edge (+0.69%) z = -1.89 (p = 0.03); props are 70% of all bets, so they drive the overall z = -1.70. With 8 kinds tested, P(at least one z <= -2.33) = 0.08 and P(at least one <= -1.89) = 0.22, and props are the largest group, so the lowest z is likeliest there. Football z = -1.86 (322 bets, 28 games). Props ROI -8.21% [-16.85, +1.23] (463 bets, 80 games). Grading: 7 NCAAF losses were graded from Novig's silence alone (kept in the file as gradeNote), all confirmed by ESPN finals (RESEARCH 87.1); the only wrong grades found were the two imported legs above (+$1.62 shortfall).
findings.suggestedAction: No action; ~1,700 bets would be needed to see a 5% ROI. Re-check when 400 more props with a close exist.
